title: Ramp pinned before/after
description: A pinned storytelling section: the stage sticks under the header for three screens of scrolling while a centred headline, subline and wide media frame (the 'before') fade out, and a second headline and frame (the 'after') rise in to replace them. Light, quiet and centred.
notes: 300% of the window tall from lg, 200% on phones; the swap is scrubbed by a CSS view timeline
browsers without scroll-driven animations, and reduced motion, show the two scenes one after the other
topOffset should match the height of a sticky header above it
